labkit.ui.plot.offsetData

Offset data coordinates by normalized axes fractions.

Syntax

xyOut = labkit.ui.plot.offsetData(ax, xy, offsetFraction)

Inputs

ax
target MATLAB axes or uiaxes handle.
xy
N-by-2 numeric data coordinates.
offsetFraction
1-by-2 or N-by-2 axes-fraction offsets. For example, [0.03 -0.04] moves a label slightly right and down in visual axes space, including on log or reversed axes.

Outputs

xyOut
N-by-2 offset data coordinates.

Related APIs

  • labkit.ui.plot.clampData — Clamp data coordinates inside the visible axes box.
